case.description: Short run using the real Section 2.1 geometry and parameter preset extracted from the downloaded COMSOL model.

notes: The Python models use the same 2.1 geometry and main kinetic parameters, but they are still simplified reconstructions rather than the original paper COMSOL file.
The COMSOL entry below is from the fresh Python-built COMSOL model, not from directly solving the original paper mph file.
Receiver I2 agrees closely across all runs at this short time; receiver total RNA is more sensitive to discretization and implementation details.
